title: Specimen Collection Appointments — Booking Channels and Booking Windows by Visit Type
content:
Scheduling desk schedule for **Specimen Collection Appointments** at Halverson Clinical Laboratories. It lists, for each of the seven visit types, whether the visit exists only by appointment, who may book it, and how far ahead and how close to the date it may be booked.

## Schedule

| Visit type | By appointment only | Patient may use the online scheduler | Provider office or care facility may book | Same-day booking | Booking horizon (calendar days) | Minimum lead (calendar days) | Waitlist for earlier slots |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Patient Service Center Walk-In Visit | No | No | No | Yes | 0 | 0 | No |
| Patient Service Center Scheduled Appointment | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 30 | 0 | Yes |
| Fasting Priority Appointment | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| Timed Glucose Tolerance Collection | Yes | No | Yes | No | 30 | 1 | No |
| Pediatric Collection Appointment | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | 45 | 2 | No |
| Facility Bedside Collection Visit | Yes | No | Yes | No | 60 | 1 | No |

## Meaning of each column

- **By appointment only** — "No" means the visit type is not booked ahead: the visit is opened when the patient arrives (the walk-in visit).
- **Online scheduler** — whether the patient can book this visit type through the online scheduler.
- **Provider office or care facility may book** — whether the ordering provider's office or the care facility can book on the patient's behalf.
- **Same-day booking** — whether a visit may be booked for the booking date itself.
- **Booking horizon** — the calendar days ahead of the booking date for which a visit may be booked; 0 means no advance booking.
- **Minimum lead** — the calendar days that must separate the booking date from the appointment date.
- **Waitlist** — whether the patient can join a waitlist for an earlier slot.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical booking dates)

The cases below use an invented booking day "D" and only the figures in the table.

| Visit type | Booking made on day D | Earliest appointment date | Latest appointment date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Patient Service Center Scheduled Appointment | D | D itself (same-day booking allowed, minimum lead 0) | D plus 30 calendar days |
| Fasting Priority Appointment | D | D plus 1 calendar day | D plus 30 calendar days |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | D | D plus 2 calendar days | D plus 45 calendar days |
| Facility Bedside Collection Visit | D | D plus 1 calendar day | D plus 60 calendar days |

**Points of reading**

- A Mobile In-Home Collection Visit requested on day D for day D plus 1 falls short of the 2-day minimum lead; one requested for day D plus 2 meets it.
- A Facility Bedside Collection Visit cannot be booked by the patient through the online scheduler; its online column reads "No" while its provider/facility column reads "Yes".
- The Patient Service Center Walk-In Visit has a horizon of 0 and is not booked ahead at all.
